body.title: The migration write
body.summary: Add src/workflow/convert/migrated-head.ts with writeMigratedHead: under ArtifactStore.exclusive append each migrated log entry whose id is not found in History.log (stamp and review entries first, the revision-bearing entry last), then replace the head with writeAtomic, keeping meta.revision, status and approval; refuse a head whose revision number, status or approval would change. Test src/workflow/convert/__tests__/migrated-head.test.ts: an approved head keeps its revision number, status and approval, and a crash injected after each step then a rerun leaves one entry per id.
acceptanceChecks: An approved head keeps its revision number, status and approval and passes checkHeadIntegrity and checkIntegrity
A crash after any step followed by a rerun leaves one migrated entry per id and the same bytes as an uninterrupted run
A write that would change revision, status or approval is refused and nothing is written for the head

tests.name: migrated-head.test.ts: an approved head keeps its revision number, status and approval and a crash at each step then a rerun leaves one entry per id
